checks.q: Are ZK-SNARK proof verifications complete and sound?
Is the nullifier mechanism preventing double-spending?
Is the commitment scheme binding and hiding?
Are Merkle tree updates for the commitment set correct?
Is the protocol resistant to the trusted setup compromise (if applicable)?
Are denomination amounts fixed to maintain the anonymity set?
Is the relayer mechanism preventing deanonymization?
Are compliance features (view keys, audit keys) properly implemented?
Is the protocol resistant to statistical deanonymization?
Are ZK circuits audited for under-constrained signals?
